description: Representative Honua Studio AI generation corpus. Derived (no AI) from the 8 generators in honua-server/src/Honua.Ai/Features/* and the WorkflowNodeRegistry. Each generation endpoint shares the request shape { prompt, provider?, model?, <current document?>, conversation?, answers? } and returns { status: generated|needs-clarification|unsupported|error, <document>, rationale?, clarifications[], validation, capabilityState }. expected_behavior is the canonical status the prompt should drive toward; pass_criteria is human/LLM-judgeable text. held_out scenarios are eval-only and must never be used for tuning or few-shot.

difficultyLevels.happy: Terse, unambiguous request squarely inside the capability surface.
difficultyLevels.variation: Realistic parameter/source/style variation or multi-part request that stresses mapping breadth.
difficultyLevels.vague: Under-specified or off-surface request that should drive a clarification or an unsupported/unmapped response rather than a confident wrong answer.
difficultyLevels.jargon: Domain-jargon phrasing that must still map to the right capability.

scenarios.prompt: Buffer the parcels layer by 100 meters and save the result.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns a workflow graph containing a process:geometry.buffer (or analytics.buffer-aggregate) node with distance 100m, a source for parcels, and a sink. Validation status not error.

scenarios.prompt: Nightly job: copy new assessor parcels into a working layer, stamp a 'reviewed' flag with a calculated field, then compute parcel area and write the result out as GeoJSON.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph chains copy-features -> calculate-field -> geometry.area -> a geojson sink, with edges in dependency order. Validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Read incidents from a CSV, cluster the points with DBSCAN, and export the clusters.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph includes source.csv -> analytics.cluster (DBSCAN params) -> a sink. Node types resolve from the registry.

scenarios.prompt: Derive slope and hillshade from the DEM, then run a TPI rugosity pass.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph references surface.slope, surface.hillshade and surface.rugosity-tpi nodes against a raster source. Validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Enrich each crash record with the police district it falls inside, then push the enriched features to our external PostGIS warehouse.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph uses analytics.spatial-join (within/intersects predicate) and a sink.external-postgis node. Validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Clean up my data and make it nicer.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications[] asking what layer, what 'clean up' means (dedup? make-valid? simplify?), and desired output. Does NOT fabricate a confident multi-node graph.

scenarios.prompt: Dissolve the zoning polygons by zone_code and simplify the boundaries.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph uses generalization.dissolve (by zone_code) and a simplify node. Validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: ogr2ogr the source shapefile into 4326 and reproject the raster to web mercator with gdalwarp.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Graph references gdal.ogr2ogr and gdal.gdalwarp (or conversion.raster-reproject) with target SRIDs. Validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Train a deep-learning model to predict next year's flood extents and email me the forecast every Monday.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns unsupported (or unmappedRequests covering ML training + email scheduling) rather than inventing nonexistent nodes. May still scaffold any supported sub-part.

scenarios.prompt: Show the roads layer on a light basemap.
scenarios.pass_criteria: MapPackage has one operational layer bound to roads and a light/streets basemap. Status generated, validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Build a map with parcels, zoning, and streets. Color high-value parcels red, show zoning as semi-transparent fills, and add a legend.
scenarios.pass_criteria: MapPackage has 3 layers, a style hint for the red high-value parcels and transparent zoning, and a legend enabled. Unmapped style requests, if any, surfaced in unmappedRequests rather than dropped.

scenarios.prompt: Give me a satellite imagery basemap centered on Honolulu.
scenarios.pass_criteria: MapPackage selects an imagery/satellite basemap and an initial view near Honolulu. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Make me a map.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications asking which layers/data and extent, OR a minimal defensible default map with explicit assumptions in rationale. Does not silently invent unrelated layers.

scenarios.prompt: Overlay the live NEXRAD radar mosaic and the parcels layer.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Parcels layer mapped; the NEXRAD/live-radar source (not a seeded layer) appears in unmappedRequests or a clarification, not silently fabricated as an existing layer.

scenarios.prompt: Create a simple map viewer app for the parcels map.
scenarios.pass_criteria: studio-app/v1 package with a map/viewer component bound to the parcels map. Status generated, validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Build an app with a map on the left and a feature table on the right that stays in sync with the map selection.
scenarios.pass_criteria: App package has a split/side-by-side layout with map + table components. Sync behavior captured in config or noted in rationale.

scenarios.prompt: Make a field data collection app where crews can add tree-inventory points with photos.
scenarios.pass_criteria: App package includes a data-entry/form component for point capture with attachment support. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: I need an app for my team.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications about app purpose (viewer? collection? dashboard?), data binding, and audience. No confident fabricated app.

scenarios.prompt: Dashboard showing the total count of open incidents.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Dashboard document (honua dashboard schema) with a single metric/KPI panel bound to incident count. routeSlug present. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Operations dashboard: incidents per week as a line chart, incidents by type as a bar chart, and a map of recent incidents with a date filter.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Document has >=3 panels (time-series line, bar-by-type, map) plus a date filter control. Vega-Lite chart specs validate structurally.

scenarios.prompt: Show me how things are going.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications about which dataset/metrics and time window, or a clearly-assumption-labelled minimal dashboard. Not a confident unrelated dashboard.

scenarios.prompt: One-page executive summary report of the parcels dataset.
scenarios.pass_criteria: report-document.v1 with a single section/page summarizing parcels, routeSlug present. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Quarterly assessment report with three sections: an overview map, a chart of value distribution, and a table of the top 10 parcels by assessed value.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Document has 3 sections containing a map, a chart, and a ranked table respectively. Chart spec validates structurally.

scenarios.prompt: Write up the findings.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications about which dataset/findings, audience, and sections. Not a fabricated report on unrelated data.

scenarios.prompt: Five-question public feedback form with name, email, rating, category, and comments.
scenarios.pass_criteria: FormPackageDocument with 5 fields of appropriate types (text, email, rating/number, select, multiline text). Status generated, validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Field form to report storm damage: capture the location on the map, severity (low/medium/high), a description, and let them attach up to 3 photos.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Form has a geometry-capture field, a severity select, a text field, and an attachment field (multi). Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Inspection form where the 'defect details' question only shows if the inspector answered 'failed' to the pass/fail question.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Form includes a pass/fail field and a conditionally-visible defect-details field gated on 'failed'. If conditional logic is unsupported, it must surface in validation/unmapped, not be silently dropped.

scenarios.prompt: Build a form.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns clarifications about purpose and fields. Not a fabricated form.

scenarios.prompt: Buffer the schools layer by 500 meters.
scenarios.pass_criteria: AnalysisPackageContent describing analytics.buffer (or buffer-aggregate) on schools at 500m. Status generated, validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: Join each incident to the census tract that contains it and bring over the median income field.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Analysis uses analytics.spatial-join with a contains/within predicate, target=incidents, join=tracts, carrying median income. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Hex-bin the crash points into a density grid and weight by injury count.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Analysis uses analytics.density with hex grid and a weighted sum on injury count. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Find all hydrants within 100 meters of each building and count them per building.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Analysis uses a dwithin spatial-join (distance 100m) producing per-building counts. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Analyze the relationship between crime and parks.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns a clarification about what relationship (proximity? density within buffer? join?) and which layers, OR a defensible spatial-join/buffer plan with explicit assumptions. Not a fabricated unsupported statistical model.

scenarios.prompt: Incidents where severity is greater than 5.
scenarios.pass_criteria: SavedQueryContent with a filter severity > 5 against the incidents layer. Status generated, validation not error.

scenarios.prompt: All parcels that intersect the downtown business district boundary.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Query uses an intersects spatial predicate against a downtown-district geometry/layer. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: High-severity incidents (severity >= 8) reported in the last 30 days that are within 250 meters of a school.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Query combines an attribute filter (severity>=8), a temporal window (last 30 days), and a dwithin spatial predicate to schools. Status generated.

scenarios.prompt: Show me the important ones.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Returns a clarification about which layer and what 'important' means. Not a fabricated arbitrary filter.
